Multiple Damage instructions within a single Power
Repeat pretending to destroy City again
answers.answer: Separate Bringer Power uses do not combine hypothetical Damage: 2 Damage to an undamaged City does not destroy it or earn Fear, and a separate 1 Damage use also does not destroy it or earn Fear. Within one Power use, 2 then 1 Damage combines to hypothetically destroy the City, earning 5 Fear without real Damage or actual destruction. A Repeat can pretend-destroy the same City again for another 5 Fear.

evidence.text: - **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. This restriction still applies when that Power's Damage/Destroy instruction names Dahan or another Spirit as the actor. An explicit instruction to Damage or Destroy Dahan does nothing to those Dahan; skip that instruction and resolve the rest of the Power normally. For each Power use, evaluate what it would destroy if resolved normally: generate **0 Fear per Explorer, 2 per Town, 5 per City**, and Push the would-be-destroyed Explorers/Towns. This special rule does not Push Cities. No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can. Existing real Damage from others helps its hypothetical destruction and remains unchanged afterward. Within a single Power use, a given Invader can be pretend-destroyed only once. Repeats can “destroy” the same piece again for Fear. It does not get bonuses conditional on **actual** destruction (e.g., Mists of Oblivion or Vengeance of the Dead) from these pretend destructions.
